## Dev Engineer Review

- GB200 single-node and multi-node stages now target `gcp-iad` cluster names.
- Regular, post-merge, and `PerfSanity` stages use the updated mappings.
- Jenkins now loads `bloom-jenkins-shared-lib@dev-mlefebvre-gcpiad`. Verify branch availability and compatibility before merge.

## QA Engineer Review

No test changes.

## Per-File QA Perspective

- `jenkins/L0_Test.groovy`: Verify that GB200 stages allocate the intended `gcp-iad` clusters and that regular, post-merge, and `PerfSanity` jobs still resolve their test lists correctly. Verify that the development shared-library branch provides all required pipeline behavior.

The Jenkins pipeline now loads a development shared-library branch and routes GB200 test and PerfSanity configurations to explicit GCP IAD platforms.

### Changes

**GB200 Jenkins routing**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Shared-library reference** <br> `jenkins/L0_Test.groovy`|The pipeline loads `bloom-jenkins-shared-lib` from `dev-mlefebvre-gcpiad` instead of `main`.|
